dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: We're here. This is the Mary-Ann Memorial Park. Let's see if there are any assets that can be recovered in this area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a park, but it doesn't look like a park at all.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: When the explosion happened, this place was hit by the first shock waves, and most of the buildings here were destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: But there might've been some paper assets that survived the blast... That's what I'm hoping, anyway.
